cardArt.title: American Express® Business Gold Plus Card

product.description: Make big plans with the metal Card that turns your business purchases into rich rewards.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Long term visa means 12 months or more and does not include a student visa.
eligibility.additionalValue: You are an Australian citizen or permanent resident or hold a long term visa.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Employee Card Members must be over 18 years of age. The Business and the Primary Card Member are jointly and severally liable for all Employee Card spending. Each employee is entitled to only one (1) Employee Card.
Must be a Director or Controller of the business
Applications are assessed based on the information provided and are subject to credit approval.

features.additionalInfo: Two Employee Cards for no extra fee then $75 p.a. for each additional Employee Card.
The Amex App lets you quickly and easily manage your Card Account anytime, anywhere.
Fraud Protection Guarantee, protecting you from unauthorised charges made on your Account.
Terms, conditions, cover limits and exclusions apply.

3 points per $1 spend at Xero, Google Ads, Meta, Amazon Web Services and Dell.
2 points per $1 spend with AccessLine®. Subject to approval. Enrolment required.
1.5 points per $1 on everyday spend.
1 point per $1 spend on government spend.
Accelerated earn rates apply on the first 200,000 points earned in a calendar year, then earn 1 point per $1 spend across all categories.

Enjoy exciting offers and deals with Amex Offers that add value to your Card Membership. Amex Offers must be saved to the Card and used for qualifying spend, subject to offer-specific criteria, to receive a benefit.
Get pre-sale tickets and access to some of your favourite events, and enjoy the Amex Entertainment Lounge before the show at select venues. With Amex, you can dive into unforgettable experiences.
Optimise your cash flow by choosing to pay off a portion of your balance, up to your FPO limit, over time. Subject to interest.
Give your business financial breathing room with up to 55 days to pay for purchases.

Receive up to US $100 hotel credit and room upgrade (when available) at selected hotels in The Hotel Collection when you book two consecutive nights’ stay through American Express Travel. Subject to availability and eligibility criteria.
Card Members receive complimentary Hilton Honors Silver status.
With Hertz Gold Plus Rewards® loyalty program, you’ll enjoy a range of benefits at participating locations across the world.
Your Business Gold Plus Card has flexible spending power, also known as no pre-set spending limit, because it is a Charge Card

Receive up to $650 credit back
We’re backing your business with up to $650 back for spend with Xero, Google Ads, Meta, Amazon Web Services, Square and Dell. That means you can get credits back for your accounting, advertising, marketing, cloud services, payments and point of sale and tech costs, until 31/12/2026. T&Cs apply.

discounts.description: American Express may, at its discretion, discount the annual fee where the customer holds an eligible American Express Personal Card and meets all other applicable eligibility criteria.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Reduced Annual Card Fee on the American Express Business Gold Plus Card as long as you continue to hold your eligible American Express Personal Card and meet all other applicable eligibility criteria.

fees.additionalInfo: Applies to the first 2 Employee Cards.
fees.name: Business Employee Card Fee (applies to first 2 Employee Cards)

fees.additionalInfo: Applies to each Employee Card from the 3rd to 99th Employee Card.
fees.name: Business Employee Card Fee (applies from the 3rd Employee Card onwards)

fees.additionalInfo: Three percent (3%) or $20, whichever is greater, will be charged on any overdue amount.
fees.additionalValue: When you do not pay the minimum payment required by the due date as shown on your statement.
fees.name: Late Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: 3.5% of the converted amount. Payable when any charge is processed in a currency other than Australian dollars.
fees.name: Currency Conversion Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $20 for each dishonour or debit rejection.
fees.name: Dishonour Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $3 Payable if you pay your Card Account in person at Australia Post by EFTPOS.
fees.name: Over The Counter Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Payable when you or the Employee Card Member requests a copy of an individual charge. $7 for charges in Australia, or $10 for other charges.
fees.name: Record of Charge Fee

lendingRates.additionalInfo: Flexible Payment Option rate applied to the portion of your statement balance carried forward up to your FPO limit.
